notes.title: Mac 2.57 + Musical Score
notes.notes:
Happily, the Mac version is up to date with the Windows edition with the latest patch. This build addresses all play reports mentioned on the boards and also eases introductions for first-time players by providing new advisory details in the beginning section.

On another turn, sections of the soundtrack are available for free download at the [url=freemusicarchive.org/music/Soul_On_Strings/] FMA [/url]

notes.title: Patch 2.4
notes.notes:
A rather important update went live today. This build corrects all known matters and in particular addresses strangeness with the phone-related features. Additionally, players can now access the Astral Body, Command Manual and Chat Cat screens from the item menu. The Mac version of this patch should appear within the week. Well wishes and season tidings

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30650608/713785fec6de8425e0b4110760d7a76d2feed7c0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Now on Mac + Patch 2.3
notes.notes:
As of tonight the Mac port is downloadable. Interestingly the port appears to perform better than its Windows counterpart in some regards. Our testing showed the game working at a distinctly higher frame rate and the monitor's colors and size seem better adjusted for its visuals.

In other news the build is current with patch 2.3. This patch addresses all known issues hitherto communicated in the forums. From this point it is unlikely future versions will be frequent.  

Peace and thanks for your patience!

notes.title: 1.77 Now Uploaded
notes.notes: A rather major update that alters the skill swap control from the 'E' key to the 'W' key has been uploaded. It includes, among other things, a number of fixes. The command manual has been updated to reflect the change. Russian fraudsters will, unfortunately, be excluded from this and all future updates.

notes.title: FAQ
notes.notes:
Q. Why isn't the game clocking my time? It says I played five minutes though 
I played for several hours.
A. We are currently working with Steam on fixing this. The game's launcher is presently incompatible with this feature.
****update**** As of 10/06/17 Steam now tracks your gameplay time

Q. Is there full screen support?
A. Yes! The game should load in full-screen by default if allowed to launch uninterrupted. Alternatively, the game can be made full-screen with 'ALT' + 'Enter'

Q. What are the controls?
A. The controls can be viewed in the game manual that is available to read from the Steam client. Alternatively, the manual is also included in the game's local files 

Q. How long is the game?
A. Beating the game in a regular play-through will likely take a minimum of 7 hours. Exploring all the content would likely require 9-10.
